description: Post-transaction verification. Code checks what it can: the response against expected_schema (a JSON Schema or a list of required field names), and a measured response time against a stated limit. A response that fails code's checks fails without the AI judge; otherwise the judge scores accuracy and completeness as advice. Without a schema or a time limit only the judge decides, and decided_by says so. Returns a verdict (pass, fail or inconclusive), decided_by, scores, format compliance, SLA result, issues, and what code checked.

expected_schema.description: A JSON Schema, or two or more required top-level field names (letters, digits, _ and -) separated by commas, e.g. 'name, price, url'. Anything else is passed to the AI judge only.

observed_response_time_ms.description: The response time you measured, in milliseconds

request_description.description: What was requested from the service

response_data.description: The actual response/output received from the service

sla_max_response_time_ms.description: The response time limit, in milliseconds

sla_requirements.description: SLA wording for the AI judge (e.g. 'must include all fields'). For a time limit code can check, use the two fields below.

name: verify_outcome
